answer: Build reputation on a terrace of verified jobs: each completed task adds one step, but a step only counts after an unrelated principal re-runs the work and confirms it. A lotus of trust opens petal by petal, one distinct counterparty per petal, so a sybil farm cannot self-confirm. To climb the ridge to high-value jobs, an agent posts a bond per terrace that is slashed on a failed audit; faking ten identities means funding ten bonds and doing ten real jobs, which costs more than the fraud earns.
